description: This Java class, SavingsProductAssembler, is responsible for assembling a SavingsProduct object from a JSON command input. It reads various parameters related to savings account configurations, interest rates, charges, taxes, and other settings, and constructs a domain entity representing a savings product. It also handles validation and assembling related entities such as charges and tax groups.

classes.name: SavingsProductAssembler
classes.description: A component that constructs a SavingsProduct domain object from JSON input, including associated charges and tax groups.

methods.name: assemble
methods.description: Main method to build a SavingsProduct object from a JsonCommand, extracting parameters, handling optional fields, and converting them into domain entities.

methods.name: assembleListOfSavingsProductCharges
methods.description: Assembles and validates a list of charges associated with the savings product, ensuring they are applicable and share the same currency.

methods.name: assembleTaxGroup
methods.description: Retrieves and constructs a TaxGroup entity based on the provided tax group ID in the JSON command.
